subject: Action required: stalled payment for INV-3347 — ACH token expired, wire fallback?
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Maria Delgado <maria.delgado@everglen.com>, Everglen AP <ap@everglen.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Action required: stalled payment for INV-3347 — ACH token expired, wire fallback?

Hi Maria / AP team,

Following up on invoice INV-3347 (due 2027-06-01). Our bank attempted the scheduled ACH pull yesterday but the token returned a permanent failure — looks like the company ACH token on file has expired in your gateway.

To avoid service disruption, we can accept a one-time wire this week. I attached the original invoice (invoice_INV-3347.pdf) and a PDF with wire instructions (wire_instructions_redwood.pdf). If you prefer to re-authorize ACH, we can delay, but we need confirmation by EOD Monday (2027-06-06) so we can keep the reserved capacity active.

Two quick asks so we can process on your side:
- If procurement requires a PO number, reply with the PO and we’ll reissue an invoice that includes it.
- If your AP needs tax paperwork, I attached our W-9 (W9_RedwoodInc.pdf). If you need any other VAT/residency evidence, let me know.

If you can wire, please include INV-3347 in the payment reference and send a brief remittance note once the transfer is initiated.

Attachment(s): invoice_INV-3347.pdf (PDF) — original invoice; wire_instructions_redwood.pdf (PDF); W9_RedwoodInc.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Maria Delgado <maria.delgado@everglen.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Everglen AP <ap@everglen.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Action required: stalled payment for INV-3347 — ACH token expired, wire fallback?

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the heads up.

We saw the failed ACH attempt and unfortunately our treasury team is in the middle of a payments platform migration this month; a number of tokens expired during the cutover. I chatted with Procurement — they will only approve a wire if the invoice contains our PO number and the invoice format matches the supplier onboarding record.

Two items from our side:
1) Can you reissue the invoice with PO# P-45219 populated in the invoice header? Procurement needs that exact field to match.
2) Who should our AP attach the remittance confirmation to once wired? Please provide the remittance email/mobile contact so it routes correctly.

If you can’t reissue quickly we could do a short exception, but I need Treasury’s approval first. Appreciate the W-9 — we’ll keep it on file.

Thanks,

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action required: stalled payment for INV-3347 — ACH token expired, wire fallback?

Hi Maria — thanks for the quick reply and for flagging the PO requirement.

I’ve attached a revised invoice with PO# P-45219 populated (Attachment: invoice_INV-3347.pdf — updated). For convenience, I’m also reattaching a short wire instruction sheet (wire_instructions_redwood.pdf) with the exact beneficiary reference string we need: INV-3347 / EVG-2027-3347.

Wire instructions (summary):
- Bank: Northern Pacific Bank
- Account name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Account #: 987654321
- Routing (ABA): 021000021
- Reference: INV-3347 / EVG-2027-3347

If Treasury needs a one-time exception instead, we can accept a scanned approval from Procurement via email to ap@redwood.com with the PO number and an authorizing signature. Once the wire is sent, please reply with the transaction reference and an expected settlement date so I can mark the invoice as paid on our side.

Attachment(s): invoice_INV-3347.pdf (PDF, updated with PO); wire_instructions_redwood.pdf (PDF)

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Maria Delgado <maria.delgado@everglen.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Action required: stalled payment for INV-3347 — ACH token expired, wire fallback?

Hi Stephanie / Ben,

Thanks for the updated invoice and the wire details. Treasury approved the one-time exception this morning. We initiated a bank wire with reference "INV-3347 / EVG-2027-3347" at 09:05 ET. Expected settlement: today (2027-06-06) afternoon. Transaction reference: TRX-20270606-8872.

We attached our remittance stub for your records. Please confirm when funds hit your account and we’ll close the AP ticket on our side. VAT note: procurement confirmed no withholding applies for this vendor; W-9 is on file.

Attachment(s): everglen_remittance_stub_3347.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Maria Delgado

Everglen Therapeutics
